description.value: Blenz Coffee is a Canadian specialty coffee chain founded in 1992, offering hand-crafted espresso drinks, organic whole-leaf teas, protein shakes, and a range of baked goods, sandwiches, and wraps. This Granville Street location sits in a well-trafficked Vancouver commercial corridor and is listed in the chain's own store locator as the Granville & Davie downtown outlet. The brand emphasizes premium natural ingredients and a loyalty rewards app.
